title: Localizing A[x_1..x_r]/(f_1x_1+...+f_rx_r-1) at f_i gives a polynomial ring over A_{f_i}
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge1$, $f_1,\dots,f_r\in A$, and $B=A[x_1,\dots,x_r]/(f_1x_1+\dots+f_rx_r-1)$ (quotient of the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] by the principal ideal; $ ar x_j$ the class of $x_j$). Fix $i\in\{1,\dots,r\}$; let $A_{f_i}$ be the localization of $A$ at $\{1,f_i,f_i^2,\dots\}$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] and $B_{f_i}$ the localization of $B$ at the powers of the image of $f_i$, and regard $B_{f_i}$ as an $A_{f_i}$-algebra via the ring map $A_{f_i}	o B_{f_i}$, $a/f_i^e\mapsto a/f_i^e$ (induced by $A	o B$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-away-universal-property]). Let $A_{f_i}[y_j:j
e i]$ be the polynomial ring over $A_{f_i}$ in the $r-1$ variables $y_j$, $j\in\{1,\dots,r\}\setminus\{i\}$. Then the $A_{f_i}$-algebra homomorphism $A_{f_i}[y_j:j
e i]	o B_{f_i}$ with $y_j\mapsto  ar x_j/1$ is an isomorphism; its inverse sends $ ar x_j/1\mapsto y_j$ for $j
e i$ and $ ar x_i/1\mapsto f_i^{-1} igl(1-\sum_{j
e i}f_jy_j igr)$.

lean.statement: theorem linearEquationLocalizationPolynomial (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (i : Fin r) : let I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r) A) := Ideal.span {(∑ j : Fin r, C (f j) * X j) - 1} let B := MvPolynomial (Fin r) A ⧸ I let q := Ideal.Quotient.mk I let Af := Localization.Away (f i) let Bf := Localization.Away (algebraMap A B (f i)) letI : Algebra Af Bf := (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) (f i)).toAlgebra let x : Fin r → Bf := fun j ↦ algebraMap B Bf (q (X j)) ∃ e : MvPolynomial {j : Fin r // j ≠ i} Af ≃ₐ[Af] Bf, e.toAlgHom = aeval (fun j ↦ x j.1) ∧ (∀ j : {j : Fin r // j ≠ i}, e.symm (x j.1) = X j) ∧ e.symm (x i) = C (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Af) (f i)) * (1 - ∑ j : {j : Fin r // j ≠ i}, C (algebraMap A Af (f j.1)) * X j)
